title: PipelineAnalyzeProposalResponse
description: Dry analyze over a not-yet-created PipelineProposal (HEL-381): the projected source schema per root, per-step input/output schema, any per-step validation errors, and (HEL-914 task 6b.4a) every proposed Output's fieldMapping validity grounded at that Output's own target node (or root schema, for a root-bound Output) -- never the pipeline trunk. Nothing is persisted. Additive sibling of GET /api/pipelines/:id/analyze's PipelineAnalyzeResponse -- carries no id/outputDataTypeId, since nothing has been created yet (design.md D4). HEL-914: `sourceName`/`sourceSchema` (singular) REPLACED outright by `sourceSchemas`, one entry per proposed root, reusing the persisted-pipeline twin's `RootSourceSchema` $def by cross-file $ref. The `sourceSchemas`, `steps` and `warnings` items are cross-file $refs into pipeline-analyze-response.schema.json ($defs.RootSourceSchema, $defs.AnalyzeStep, $defs.AnalyzeWarning, and through them $defs.SchemaField), resolved offline by the backend schema test harness's helio.local URI mapping (HEL-1419); no copy of those defs lives here, so the two shapes cannot drift. Only $defs.OutputAnalyze is proposal-specific.

warnings.description: HEL-1235: schema-only, NON-BLOCKING pre-run findings, computed from the inferred schemas with no row reads. Always present (empty when none). Never sets a step's validationError, never affects costVerdict (canRun/autoRunnable/reasons), never blocks a write or an auto-run. Wording states the evidence base (the stored inferred schema can be stale). Distinct from propose_pipeline's `warnings: string[]` (which drives applyReady) and from run warnings.

OutputAnalyze.description: HEL-914 task 6b.4a: one entry per proposed Output, in request order. `validationError` is present only when that Output's fieldMapping is invalid at its own grounded node -- absent when valid or when the Output has no fieldMapping.
